cards.sub: Meet someone, argue one question, and the AI judge decides who won.
Free to try. Sign in with Google to meet someone.

cards.text: Say what you like arguing about.
We find you a real person.
One question. You get a side. Start talking.
The AI keeps shared notes on both sides while you argue.
Done? Both of you agree to finish.
The AI judge decides, and shows its work.
Both people get a score out of 100.
Wins move you up the leaderboard.
Or just watch other people argue.
Nobody around? Debate the AI out loud.
Pick a topic and a side.
It argues back, and interrupts, like a person.
